module: Zone boundaries of drift mode. Loads a sites file (zones) with setBounds, then, every frame, checks for each vehicle tracked by gameplay_drift_drift whether it is in at least one zone; otherwise it is "out of bounds". A drift mission modder reads getIsOutOfBounds(vehId) to penalize the player. Also contains an ImGui debug window and a profiler.
notes: setBounds: the drawBounds_ parameter is poorly handled: only the nil case sets drawBounds to true; a provided true/false value is never copied. Also drawZones() (drawing the zones, flashing red when out of bounds) is commented out in onUpdate, so nothing is drawn.
Depends on gameplay_drift_drift (getTrackedVehicles, getVehPos) and gameplay_drift_general (debug); untracked vehicles are removed from the state.
getIsOutOfBounds without argument returns true if any tracked vehicle is out of bounds (compatibility).
A position outside all the zones of the sites file (sites:getZonesForPosition returns 0 zones) is considered out of bounds.

getDriftDebugInfo.desc: Debug configuration table of the extension: {default = false, canBeChanged = true}.

getGC.desc: Lua garbage produced by the last frame measured by the profiler (0 if general debug is off).

getIsOutOfBounds.desc: Indicates whether a vehicle is outside the boundary zones.

vehId.desc: Vehicle ID; nil = true if any tracked vehicle is out of bounds.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: updates the out-of-bounds state of each tracked vehicle, the debug window and the profiler.

setBounds.desc: Loads the sites file that defines the allowed zones (gameplay_sites_sitesManager.loadSites then finalizeSites) and empties the vehicle state.

filePath.desc: Path of the sites file containing the zones.

drawBounds_.desc: Drawing of the zones (nil = active); see notes, the provided value is ignored.
